name: snooze-popover
title: Snooze popover
description: Snooze until later: presets for this evening, tomorrow and next week worked out from now, plus a date and time of your own, with the zone said aloud.
docs: Pass onSnooze(date), the moment of the choice, and a now, a timeZone and a locale: every choice is worked out from now on the calendar of that zone through Intl (never the zone of the machine, daylight saving included), so the server and the browser agree; without now the browser's clock is read once the page is live. The four default choices are Later today (18:00), Tomorrow morning (08:00), This weekend (Saturday 09:00, not offered on a Sunday) and Next week (Monday 08:00), each with the day and the time at the right ('Tomorrow, 08:00', 'Sat 24 Oct, 09:00'), and a choice that would land in the past is left out. Pass presets ({ id, label, resolve(now, timeZone) }) to replace them: resolve returns a Date, or null when the choice does not apply, and atTime and nextWeekday in snooze.ts do the zone work. 'Pick date and time' opens the Calendar and a time field (the house select, in half hours, written the way the locale writes a time), writes the choice out in words ('Snooze until Thu 23 Oct, 08:00') and refuses a time that has passed, so the slots that have gone are off for today; the zone is said in full words at the foot. onSnooze may return a promise: the row shows progress, and a rejection keeps the panel open with a message. A choice closes the popover and is announced from the button ('Snoozed until Thu 23 Oct, 08:00'). The list is one tab stop with the arrow keys, and Enter on a choice snoozes it; in the calendar view Enter on the Snooze button, or Ctrl or Command with Enter from anywhere in it, confirms. trigger replaces the button, open, defaultOpen and onOpenChange control the popover, SnoozePanel is the inside on its own, and labels translates every word.
